fields.name: asset_id
fields.meaning: id 0x28E..0x3D6, 83 distinct, not the table index (the reader's index is an external descriptor's +0x06 halfword)

fields.name: index_a
fields.meaning: index into the 4-byte word table at 0x0806BCE8, read at pc 0x080319A4; equals asset_id + 1

fields.name: index_b
fields.meaning: same table's index space; equals asset_id + 2

fields.name: index_c
fields.meaning: index into the same table, read at pc 0x080319B0; equals asset_id + 3

fields.name: width_a
fields.meaning: piece 0 width, same column shape as the read width_b

fields.name: frame_a
fields.meaning: piece 0 data address inside the asset bank

fields.name: width_b
fields.meaning: piece 1 width, read as a half extent at pc 0x08032330

fields.name: height_b
fields.meaning: piece 1 height, read as a half extent at pc 0x08032338

fields.name: attr_b
fields.meaning: piece 1 attribute/flags word, same 4 values as attr_a

fields.name: frame_b
fields.meaning: piece 1 data address, passed as an argument at pc 0x0803232C

fields.name: span
fields.meaning: bounded integer 0..0x1D4C, zero in 58 records; meaning unestablished

fields.name: extra
fields.meaning: optional address in the block before the bank, zero in 60 records; meaning unestablished
